method.ratio: exp(mean over paired runs of ln(coarse/fine)), coarse over fine; above 1 = the coarser or control model is worse
method.metrics: 1-auc (probes), eps_b@X (background efficiency at signal efficiency X; inverse ratio of rejections), sigma_eff (mass probes), 1-macro_auc (fine-tuning)
method.run_error: SD over runs of ln r_k / sqrt(n)
method.test_error: SD over bootstrap resamplings of the test jets, one resampling shared by both models and every run, of the mean ln r_k
method.combined: quadrature sum; 95% interval with Student t at the Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
method.pairing: run k with run k (v1: shared initialisation, not a shared stream; audit B1); random draw k with run k
method.rejection_interval: Garwood central 68.27% on the count of passing background jets
